gen-gf-mona-sans-fs-literata: Crisp and modern, Mona Sans cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap. And Literata, a text serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, takes over below to add bookish warmth.
gen-gf-monda-fs-literata: Literata keeps its thin lines sturdy and its thick ones slightly heavier. Beneath the cupped bowls of Monda, pages of text should flow smoothly, the weight gap as modest as thread against yarn.
gen-gf-noto-sans-cypriot-fs-literata: Noto Sans Cypriot keeps its counters connected to the outside space, a contemporary heading with nothing fussy about it. Literata, a serif, makes paragraphs feel bookish and unhurried, thanks to sturdy lines.
gen-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan-fs-literat: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan opens its e wide, in a professional, contemporary way. It handles crisp headings, while Literata, a serif, handles bookish text, its thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick.
gen-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohingya-fs-lite: Literata reads like a bookish text serif, with joins that thin gently without turning spindly. And Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya excels at crisp headline shapes with distinct gaps, leaving the sustained reading to Literata.
gen-gf-noto-sans-shavian-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish text serif, sturdy and sophisticated. Above it, Noto Sans Shavian adds an approachable a whose lower bowl opens, and their middling stroke contrast lets both fit together.
gen-gf-overpass-mono-fs-literata: Fixed-width, code-style letters with no stem-to-join contrast lead here. Overpass Mono sets technical precision against Literata, whose subtle swing between heavy and light strokes moves across the text.
gen-gf-oxygen-mono-fs-literata: Literata, a text serif, carries sturdy thin lines and restrained steps up to thicker ones. Literata supplies bookish warmth where Oxygen Mono supplies spacious, typewriter-like precision, and that gap in temperament is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-parastoo-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between curve ends and stem. And after Parastoo, a traditional serif whose dense glyphs the eye slides through, reading should glide along.
gen-gf-paytone-one-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curves wide-mouthed and sturdy. Paytone One, modern and clean with stretched tracking, stays closed where Literata opens up, which is the pair's whole draw.
